summary: Both round-4 defects fixed red-first; VM gate green; assigned corpus categories at zero and all 83 unrelated failure records unchanged.
body:
Changed this round:

- [import.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import.rs:251): consistently use the corrected timeline for audio-bearing layers, including source mapping, occupancy, and animation. Silent 3D media also trigger correction when they affect later audio.
- [overlay.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/overlay.rs:279): retain shared camera context within the existing work, node, and depth budgets.
- [import/tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/tests.rs:816): audio, camera-switching, coalescing, and round-trip regressions. Additional closure tests live in overlay.rs.

Earlier fixes and the existing sr_core_corpus.rs changes remain intact, including SAMPLE_REGRESSION. That file was not edited this round.

Public API unchanged:

```rust
pub fn import(bytes: &[u8], opts: &ImportOptions)
    -> Result<(Imported, Vec<Overlay>, Report)>;
```

Both findings were accepted; none rejected.

**Audio:** selecting the recovered timeline only for layers missing source maps left later sequence children on stale clocks. Every audio-bearing layer now uses the recovered timeline whenever that pass is needed. The regression preserves a=[0,2) and b=[2,4), including b’s volume animation. Semantics checked against XSD sequenceType/layerType, scene-render `sr-eval/src/program.rs::place_sequence` and `shift`, and `sr-deliver/src/audio.rs::mix_scene`.

**Cameras:** ordinary cameras select projection implicitly. Camera-bearing compositions now retain the complete composition, and existing coalescing suppresses covered native/separate video clips. This conservatively preserves 2D siblings too. Viewport cameras retain their isolated viewport scope. Camera targets, links, expressions, ordering, and intervals survive closure. Sources: [XSD cameraType](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:4377), [viewport3DType](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:5329), and scene-render `sr-eval/src/eval.rs` camera selection/`viewport_camera`. This schema has no cameraSwitch element; switching uses active flags and live intervals.

TDD: after correcting fixture schema attributes, [red run](/tmp/fixoverlay-round4-red3.log) showed all seven failures below. All pass in the [green run](/tmp/fixoverlay-round4-green.log) and final gate.

| Test | Observed red failure |
|---|---|
| scene_import_round4_audio_after_three_d_sequence_child | 1 soundtrack, expected 2 |
| scene_import_round4_audio_animation_uses_corrected_sequence_clock | Missing b soundtrack |
| scene_import_round4_audio_after_silent_three_d_sequence_child | 0 soundtracks, expected 1 |
| scene_import_round4_camera_without_target_shares_overlay | 2 overlays, expected 1 |
| scene_import_round4_camera_switch_preserves_scope_and_dependencies | 2 overlays, expected 1 |
| overlay_round4_implicit_camera_dependency_from_either_root | Camera fragment omitted box |
| overlay_round4_viewport_camera_stays_isolated | Viewport camera fragment omitted box |

[Final VM gate](/tmp/fixoverlay-round4-gate.log): formatting passed; Clippy with `-D warnings` passed; **362 tests passed, 0 failed, 3 existing ignores**; **51 Wasm crates passed**.

[Pinned corpus](/tmp/fixoverlay-round4-corpus.log), compared with the accepted [round-3 baseline](/tmp/fixoverlay-round3-corpus.log):

| Category | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| external-expression | 0 | 0 |
| generated-id | 0 | 0 |
| material-override | 0 | 0 |
| voxel-palette | 0 | 0 |
| geodesic-camera | 0 | 0 |
| fractional-depth | 11 | 11 |
| linked-audio | 72 | 72 |

All **83 unrelated failure records match exactly**, including multiplicity, case, mode, stage, and message. Totals: 1,343 cases; 2,020 imports, exports, and schema-oracle checks; 4,040 successful re-imports. The corpus command exits 101 solely for those unchanged failures.

No renderer code was borrowed this round. Retain the earlier tokenizer attribution to `scene-render/crates/sr-model/src/program_ids.rs`, revision `9ebe0889b946aea2bbb8156c1fa0bfbd2b405b84`.

Repeat-template audio remains explicitly reported as unsupported, as accepted in round 3. No commits, pushes, or new dependencies. Task completed; all locks released.
